Do not pressurize the servicing vehicle with the single point nozzle(s) open and the aircraft valve in the defueling position, which could cause injury, death, or long-term health hazards. Do not allow the PTO to operate more than five minutes without fuel flow, and do not operate the pump at speeds that cause cavitation; either could damage or destroy equipment. Check hoses and couplings for slippage and leaks; a detected leak requires shutdown and notification of the FSC. records.query: What are the Safety and equipment protocols of Military Cargo Aircraft, and how do they verify GPU/APU positioning?

Safety protocols: The CSS has full and final authority over concurrent operations (except CFR vehicle/personnel) and must report any condition jeopardizing safety; only CSS-authorized personnel may enter the concurrent servicing area; only MHE meeting section V safety requirements of TO 00-25-172 is permitted in the Fuel Servicing Safety Zone (FSSZ, 50 ft from pressurized fuel components and 25 ft from fuel vent outlets); the 25K/40K-loader open-flame heater is prohibited in the FSSZ; tandem K-loader use is not authorized for side-door aircraft (L-188, DC-9, B-727); on L-188 aircraft, MHE will not stop with engines running within 25 ft of the left-wing vent. Oxygen servicing shall not be done concurrently with fuel servicing; electrical/radio/radar/fuel maintenance and opening flammable-liquid lines are not allowed during fueling; portable or truck-mounted radio equipment must be off within 10 ft of fuel vent outlets; all personnel not involved must clear the area; a malfunction in the fueling system requires immediate shutdown; refueling pressure must not exceed 55 PSI (L-188: 300 GPM at no more than 35 PSI); stop refueling if fuel flow does not stop during precheck. Equipment: one authorized serviceable fire extinguisher, wheel chocks, grounding/bonding wires, maintenance stands bonded to the aircraft, aircraft stairs/ladders unobstructed for emergency egress, straight nozzles for underwing servicing, and a 150-lb Halon or equivalent extinguisher; the CSS wears a reflective vest marked CSS. Emergency: stop fuel flow and determine whether air freight personnel must be evacuated.

records.query: What is the difference between emergency shutdown and post-shutdown procedures as per the AFTF technical manual?

records.query: What are the procedures for installing, removing, and requisitioning vehicle markings, including reflective tape?

records.answer: Caution: High-pressure wash equipment must never be used on aircraft landing gear and components, wheels, and brakes, because it can force lubricants out of bearings and attach points and cause corrosion and wear problems.
